rome-central-italy-tivoli-and-sabine-hil.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: This Scenic stretch near Guidonia Montecelio → High point in San Cesareo stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Photo stop near Ardea → Near Selcetta is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

waypoints.name: Chiuiești - Dealul Podului

waypoints.name: back through Dobricel - Vârful Lazului

waypoints.name: Budacu de Jos - Dealul Cetății 1
waypoints.advice: Budacu de Jos - Dealul Cetății 1 closes the day.

places-budacu-de-jos-dealul-cetatii-1-ch.story: From Bistriţa it runs 158 km to Bistriţa; allow about 2 h 43 of riding. It goes by way of Șintereag - Dealul Oului, Dobricel - Vârful Lazului, Chiuiești - Dealul Podului and back through Dobricel - Vârful Lazului. The line favours views over speed.
